left.raw_text: Eligible patients are those over 18 years of age
who are regularly scheduled to undergo a right hemicolectomy via a minimally invasive approach
with the creation of an anastomosis.

right.raw_text: Right colectomy will be defined as removal of the ascending colon, ligation of the ileocolic artery and vein,

left.raw_text: +/- removal of the proximal transverse colon,

right.raw_text: +/- removal of the right branch of the middle colic artery and vein.
